description:
## Overview

src/vug/config.cr (236 lines) and src/vug/image_validator.cr (226 lines) are the two largest source files. Both have SRP violations and DRY issues that reduce readability and maintainability.

## Issues Found

### config.cr
- LogLevel and LogEntry mixed into Config (SRP)
- copy_with duplicates all 22 parameters (DRY)
- LogEntry.to_json manual JSON building is fragile (reliability)
- Validation helpers potentially reusable

### image_validator.cr  
- Format detection, validation, and dimension parsing in one module (SRP)
- gif? method has unnecessary allocations

### Cross-cutting
- Retry backoff logic duplicated
- UrlValidator logging inconsistency

## Dependency Graph

```mermaid
graph LR
    vugcr-4xz --> vugcr-2ry
    vugcr-4xz --> vugcr-8qw
    vugcr-c0b --> vugcr-bd0
```

Extract LogEntry first (4xz), then fix its to_json (2ry) and simplify copy_with (8qw). Extract dimensions (c0b), then simplify gif? (bd0). Backoff and URL validator are independent.
title: Refactor config.cr and image_validator.cr for SRP and DRY
